newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures higher on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Wednesday on short-covering, reflecting the yen's weaker tone against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.7 yen to 2.1 yen per kg higher. Benchmark March was up 1.0 yen at 134.5 yen.
The market started the day on a firmer tone following prices gains on Tuesday, the traders said.

Prices were spurred by technical factors and the currency market with little fundamental reasons behind the day's price gains. Activity was lacklustre as fresh buying by private investors remained limited amid a lack of fresh factors.
